def place_on_zone_v2(obj_name, zone_name):
    # Get grasp candidates for the object
    candidates = grasp_candidates(obj_name)
    if not candidates:
        return False
    candidate = candidates[0]
    grasp(candidate)
    
    # Verify object is now held
    if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
        return False
    
    # Try to place on target zone
    spots = free_spots(zone_name)
    if spots and spots["spots"]:
        spot = spots["spots"][0]
        carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["gripper_yaw"])
        lower_until_contact()
        open_gripper()
        retreat()
        wait(20)
        return True
    else:
        # If target zone is not free, try to find an alternative zone (e.g., purple_box)
        fallback_zone = "purple_box"
        fallback_spots = free_spots(fallback_zone)
        if not fallback_spots or not fallback_spots["spots"]:
            return False
        spot = fallback_spots["spots"][0]
        carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["gripper_yaw"])
        lower_until_contact()
        open_gripper()
        retreat()
        wait(20)
        return True
